34: public class WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitor extends AbstractMonitor
35: {
36:   private final WorkerTaskCountStatsProvider statsProvider;
37:   private final IndexerTaskCountStatsProvider indexerStatsProvider;
38:   private final String workerCategory;
39:   private final String workerVersion;
40:   private final boolean isMiddleManager;
41: 
42:   @Inject
43:   public WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitor(
44:       Injector injector,
45:       @Self Set<NodeRole> nodeRoles
46:   )
47:   {
48:     this.isMiddleManager = nodeRoles.contains(NodeRole.MIDDLE_MANAGER);
49:     if (isMiddleManager) {
50:       this.statsProvider = injector.getInstance(WorkerTaskCountStatsProvider.class);
51:       this.indexerStatsProvider = null;
52:       this.workerCategory = statsProvider.getWorkerCategory();
53:       this.workerVersion = statsProvider.getWorkerVersion();
54:     } else {
55:       this.indexerStatsProvider = injector.getInstance(IndexerTaskCountStatsProvider.class);
56:       this.statsProvider = null;
57:       this.workerCategory = null;
58:       this.workerVersion = null;
59:     }
60:   }
61: 
62:   @Override
63:   public boolean doMonitor(ServiceEmitter emitter)
64:   {
65:     if (isMiddleManager) {
66:       String category = workerCategory;
67:       String resolvedCategory = statsProvider.resolvedWorkerCategory();
68:       if (resolvedCategory != null) {
69:         category = resolvedCategory;
70:       }
71:       String version = workerVersion;
72:       String resolvedVersion = statsProvider.resolvedWorkerVersion();
73:       if (resolvedVersion != null) {
74:         version = resolvedVersion;
75:       }
76: 
77:       Long failedTaskCount = statsProvider.getWorkerFailedTaskCount();
78:       if (failedTaskCount != null) {
79:         ServiceMetricEvent.Builder failedBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
80:         failedBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.CATEGORY, category);
81:         failedBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.WORKER_VERSION, version);
82:         emitter.emit(failedBuilder.setMetric("worker/task/failed/count", failedTaskCount));
83:       }
84:       Long successfulTaskCount = statsProvider.getWorkerSuccessfulTaskCount();
85:       if (successfulTaskCount != null) {
86:         ServiceMetricEvent.Builder successBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
87:         successBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.CATEGORY, category);
88:         successBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.WORKER_VERSION, version);
89:         emitter.emit(successBuilder.setMetric("worker/task/success/count", successfulTaskCount));
90:       }
91:       Long idleTaskSlotCount = statsProvider.getWorkerIdleTaskSlotCount();
92:       if (idleTaskSlotCount != null) {
93:         ServiceMetricEvent.Builder idleBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
94:         idleBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.CATEGORY, category);
95:         idleBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.WORKER_VERSION, version);
96:         emitter.emit(idleBuilder.setMetric("worker/taskSlot/idle/count", idleTaskSlotCount));
97:       }
98:       Long totalTaskSlotCount = statsProvider.getWorkerTotalTaskSlotCount();
99:       if (totalTaskSlotCount != null) {
100:         ServiceMetricEvent.Builder totalBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
101:         totalBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.CATEGORY, category);
102:         totalBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.WORKER_VERSION, version);
103:         emitter.emit(totalBuilder.setMetric("worker/taskSlot/total/count", totalTaskSlotCount));
104:       }
105:       Long usedTaskSlotCount = statsProvider.getWorkerUsedTaskSlotCount();
106:       if (usedTaskSlotCount != null) {
107:         ServiceMetricEvent.Builder usedBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
108:         usedBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.CATEGORY, category);
109:         usedBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.WORKER_VERSION, version);
110:         emitter.emit(usedBuilder.setMetric("worker/taskSlot/used/count", usedTaskSlotCount));
111:       }
112:     } else {
113:       for (Map.Entry<String, Long> runningEntry : indexerStatsProvider.getWorkerRunningTasks().entrySet()) {
114:         Long runningCount = runningEntry.getValue();
115:         if (runningCount != null) {
116:           String runningDataSource = indexerStatsProvider.resolvedDataSourceDimension(runningEntry.getKey());
117:           if (runningDataSource == null) {
118:             runningDataSource = runningEntry.getKey();
119:           }
120:           ServiceMetricEvent.Builder runningBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
121:           runningBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.DATASOURCE, runningDataSource);
122:           emitter.emit(runningBuilder.setMetric("worker/task/running/count", runningCount));
123:         }
124:       }
125:       for (Map.Entry<String, Long> assignedEntry : indexerStatsProvider.getWorkerAssignedTasks().entrySet()) {
126:         Long assignedCount = assignedEntry.getValue();
127:         if (assignedCount != null) {
128:           String assignedDataSource = indexerStatsProvider.resolvedDataSourceDimension(assignedEntry.getKey());
129:           if (assignedDataSource == null) {
130:             assignedDataSource = assignedEntry.getKey();
131:           }
132:           ServiceMetricEvent.Builder assignedBuilder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
133:           assignedBuilder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.DATASOURCE, assignedDataSource);
134:           emitter.emit(assignedBuilder.setMetric("worker/task/assigned/count", assignedCount));
135:         }
136:       }
137:       emit(emitter, "worker/task/completed/count", indexerStatsProvider.getWorkerCompletedTasks());
138:       emit(emitter, "worker/task/failed/count", indexerStatsProvider.getWorkerFailedTasks());
139:       emit(emitter, "worker/task/success/count", indexerStatsProvider.getWorkerSuccessfulTasks());
140:     }
141:     return true;
142:   }

144:   public void emit(ServiceEmitter emitter, String metricName, Map<String, Long> dataSourceTaskMap)
145:   {
146:     for (Map.Entry<String, Long> dataSourceTaskCount : dataSourceTaskMap.entrySet()) {
147:       if (dataSourceTaskCount.getValue() != null) {
148:         ServiceMetricEvent.Builder builder = new ServiceMetricEvent.Builder();
149:         builder.setDimension(DruidMetrics.DATASOURCE, dataSourceTaskCount.getKey());
150:         emitter.emit(builder.setMetric(metricName, dataSourceTaskCount.getValue()));
151:       }
152:     }
153:   }

63: /**
64:  * Sets up the {@link MonitorScheduler} to monitor things on a regular schedule.  {@link Monitor}s must be explicitly
65:  * bound in order to be loaded.
66:  */
67: public class MetricsModule implements Module
68: {
69:   static final String MONITORING_PROPERTY_PREFIX = "druid.monitoring";
70:   private static final Logger log = new Logger(MetricsModule.class);
71:   private Set<NodeRole> nodeRoles;
72: 
73:   @Inject
74:   public void setNodeRoles(@Self Set<NodeRole> nodeRoles)
75:   {
76:     this.nodeRoles = nodeRoles;
77:   }
78: 
79:   public static void register(Binder binder, Class<? extends Monitor> monitorClazz)
80:   {
81:     DruidBinders.metricMonitorBinder(binder).addBinding().toInstance(monitorClazz);
82:   }
83: 
84:   @Override
85:   public void configure(Binder binder)
86:   {
87:     JsonConfigProvider.bind(binder, MONITORING_PROPERTY_PREFIX, DruidMonitorSchedulerConfig.class);
88:     JsonConfigProvider.bind(binder, MONITORING_PROPERTY_PREFIX, MonitorsConfig.class);
89: 
90:     DruidBinders.metricMonitorBinder(binder); // get the binder so that it will inject the empty set at a minimum.
91: 
92:     binder.bind(DataSourceTaskIdHolder.class).in(LazySingleton.class);
93: 
94:     binder.bind(ExecutorServiceMonitor.class).in(LazySingleton.class);
95: 
96:     // Instantiate eagerly so that we get everything registered and put into the Lifecycle
97:     binder.bind(Key.get(MonitorScheduler.class, Names.named("ForTheEagerness")))
98:           .to(MonitorScheduler.class)
99:           .asEagerSingleton();
100:   }
101: 
102:   @Provides
103:   @ManageLifecycle
104:   public MonitorScheduler getMonitorScheduler(
105:       Supplier<DruidMonitorSchedulerConfig> config,
106:       MonitorsConfig monitorsConfig,
107:       Set<Class<? extends Monitor>> monitorSet,
108:       ServiceEmitter emitter,
109:       Injector injector
110:   )
111:   {
112:     List<Monitor> monitors = new ArrayList<>();
113:     // HACK: when ServiceStatusMonitor is the first to be loaded, it introduces a circular dependency between
114:     // CliPeon.runTask and CliPeon.getDataSourceFromTask/CliPeon.getTaskIDFromTask. The reason for this is unclear
115:     // but by injecting DataSourceTaskIdHolder early this cycle is avoided.
116:     injector.getInstance(DataSourceTaskIdHolder.class);
117:     for (Class<? extends Monitor> monitorClass : Iterables.concat(monitorsConfig.getMonitors(), monitorSet)) {
118:       monitors.add(injector.getInstance(monitorClass));
119:     }
120: 
121:     if (!monitors.isEmpty()) {
122:       log.info(
123:           "Loaded %d monitors: %s",
124:           monitors.size(),
125:           monitors.stream().map(monitor -> monitor.getClass().getName()).collect(Collectors.joining(", "))
126:       );
127:     }
128: 
129:     if (ClockDriftSafeMonitorScheduler.class.getName().equals(config.get().getSchedulerClassName())) {
130:       return new ClockDriftSafeMonitorScheduler(
131:           config.get(),
132:           emitter,
133:           monitors,
134:           CronScheduler.newBuilder(Duration.ofSeconds(1L)).setThreadName("MonitorScheduler").build(),
135:           Execs.singleThreaded("MonitorRunner")
136:       );
137:     } else if (BasicMonitorScheduler.class.getName().equals(config.get().getSchedulerClassName())) {
138:       return new BasicMonitorScheduler(
139:           config.get(),
140:           emitter,
141:           monitors,
142:           Execs.scheduledSingleThreaded("MonitorScheduler-%s")
143:       );
144:     } else {
145:       throw new IAE("Unknown monitor scheduler[%s]", config.get().getSchedulerClassName());
146:     }
147:   }

part.text:
Fixed. The regression from PR #15991 was that `WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitor` unconditionally called `injector.getInstance(IndexerTaskCountStatsProvider.class)` for any non-Middle-Manager node, but that binding only exists in `CliIndexer` — not in Peons (services/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/cli/CliMiddleManager.java:147 vs CliIndexer.java:163).

Changes in `server/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/server/metrics/WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitor.java`:
- The constructor now looks up `IndexerTaskCountStatsProvider` via `injector.getExistingBinding(Key.get(...))` and leaves the provider `null` when it isn't bound (as on Peons), so injector creation no longer fails.
- `doMonitor` skips emission when `indexerStatsProvider` is null.

Verified: `WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitorTest` (4 tests, incl. `testMonitorWithPeon`) and `MetricsModuleTest` (10 tests) all pass.
